description: The Light's own healer - throughput, Renew and group restoration.

nodes.name: Healing Focus
nodes.description: Reduces the cost of your Heal by 5% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 0: 'Reduces the pushback suffered from damaging attacks while casting any healing spell by 35%/70%.' DEPARTURE - there are no cast times and so no pushback. The talent exists so a healer keeps healing under fire; delivered as cost. _cost_pct is a FRACTION where POSITIVE IS A REDUCTION. Kept from the outgoing tree, corrected from 3 ranks to the real 2.

nodes.name: Improved Renew
nodes.description: Increases the healing of your Renew by 5% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 0: 'Increases the amount healed by your Renew spell by 5%/10%/15%.' Built verbatim over the real 3 ranks; the outgoing version had 5 ranks. USES _healing, not _damage.

nodes.name: Holy Specialization
nodes.description: Increases your spell critical chance by 1% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 0: 'Increases the critical effect chance of your Holy spells by 1%-5%.' Built verbatim - crit_chance_spell covers all spells rather than one school, and every Priest heal here is Holy. Kept from the outgoing tree.

nodes.name: Desperate Prayer
nodes.description: Being struck hard mends you, healing over 2 turns.
nodes._source: WotLK row 1: 'Instantly heals the caster for 263 to 325.' DEPARTURE - there is no priest_desperate_prayer ability to unlock. Delivered as a reactive self-heal with icd 4, which keeps it a cooldown rather than constant healing. A proc-applied hot states PER-TURN healing as `potency`. The outgoing version granted max_health_pct, which is not this talent.

nodes.name: Spell Warding
nodes.description: Reduces all spell damage taken by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 1, NEW to our tree, built verbatim: 'Reduces all spell damage taken by 2%-10%.' spell_damage_taken_pct is a FRACTION as a talent effect and NEGATIVE reduces - the opposite sign to its meaning inside a status effect.

nodes.name: Blessed Recovery
nodes.description: Being critically struck heals you over 2 turns.
nodes._source: WotLK row 1: 'After being struck by a melee or ranged critical hit, Blessed Recovery heals you for 5%/10%/15% of the damage taken over 6 sec.' DEPARTURE on the trigger - there is no on-crit-TAKEN event, so on_damage_taken with icd 1 stands in. Healing as a percentage of the damage taken is also unavailable: of the payloads that read the triggering amount, none applies a hot. 6 seconds is 2 turns. Kept as a proc from the outgoing tree.

nodes.name: Divine Fury
nodes.description: Increases the damage of your Smite and Holy Fire and the healing of your Heal by 3% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 1: 'Reduces the casting time of your Smite, Holy Fire, Heal and Greater Heal spells by 0.1-0.5 sec.' DEPARTURE - no cast times. A shorter cast is more throughput, so it is delivered as throughput on the three named spells that exist. NOTE the Heal clause uses _healing and the damage clauses use _damage - mixing them on one node is correct and getting it wrong is the 18-dead-talents mistake. Kept from the outgoing tree. It is Searing Light's prerequisite in the real tree, preserved below.

nodes.name: Inspiration
nodes.description: Your critical heals harden the target against physical damage.
nodes._source: WotLK row 1: 'Reduces your target's physical damage taken by 5%/10% for 15 sec after getting a critical effect from your Flash Heal, Heal or Greater Heal.' Built with the real 10% and 15 seconds as 4 turns. on_target is False because a talent-sourced effect cannot be aimed at the heal's recipient, so the priest carries it - a real departure. MIND THE UNIT: inside a status effect physical_damage_taken_pct is PERCENTAGE POINTS (-10.0), unlike the BARE damage_taken_pct in the same position, which is read raw. Kept as a proc from the outgoing tree.

nodes.name: Holy Reach
nodes.description: Increases the healing of your Circle of Healing and Prayer of Healing by 5% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 2: 'Increases the range of your Smite and Holy Fire spells and the radius of your Prayer of Healing, Holy Nova, Divine Hymn and Circle of Healing spells by 10%/20%.' DEPARTURE - there is no range or radius in this engine. A wider heal reaches more people, so it is delivered as healing on the two group heals that exist. Kept from the outgoing tree.

nodes.name: Healing Prayers
nodes.description: Reduces the cost of your Prayer of Healing by 10% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 2: 'Reduces the mana cost of your Prayer of Healing and Prayer of Mending spell by 10%/20%.' Prayer of Mending does not exist. Kept from the outgoing tree, which used the FLAT _cost key.

nodes.name: Improved Healing
nodes.description: Reduces the cost of your Heal and Penance by 5% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 2: 'Reduces the mana cost of your Lesser Heal, Heal, Greater Heal, Divine Hymn and Penance spells by 5%/10%/15%.' Built verbatim for the two that exist. Stacks with Healing Focus on priest_heal. Kept from the outgoing tree.

nodes.name: Spirit of Redemption
nodes.description: Increases your Spirit by 5%.
nodes._source: WotLK row 2: 'Increases total Spirit by 5% and upon death, the priest becomes the Spirit of Redemption for 15 sec.' The Spirit half is verbatim. DEPARTURE on the second - there is no on-death hook and no post-death state. The outgoing version granted FLAT spirit; spirit_pct is PERCENTAGE POINTS. It feeds Spiritual Guidance one column across.

nodes.name: Searing Light
nodes.description: Increases the damage of your Smite, Holy Fire and Penance by 5% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 2, built verbatim for the three real spells that exist: 'Increases the damage of your Smite, Holy Fire, Holy Nova and Penance spells by 5%/10%.' The real talent requires Divine Fury, which connected_to reproduces. Kept from the outgoing tree, corrected from 3 ranks to the real 2.

nodes.name: Spiritual Guidance
nodes.description: Increases your spell power by 5% of your Spirit per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 2, built verbatim: 'Increases spell power by 5%-25% of your total Spirit.' A REAL stat conversion - spell_power is a valid STAT_CONVERSION_TARGET and spirit a valid source. THE UNIT IS A RAW MULTIPLIER, not a percentage: character.py:1551 does `gained = source * pct`, so 0.05 per rank reaches the real 25%. Authoring 25 would have granted twenty-five times the priest's Spirit as spell power. The outgoing version granted FLAT spirit and FLAT healing_power, which is neither the conversion nor its magnitude.

nodes.name: Surge of Light
nodes.description: Your spell criticals have a 50% chance per rank to make your next spells cheaper for 2 turns.
nodes._source: WotLK row 3, NEW to our tree: 'Your spell criticals have a 25%/50% chance to cause your next Smite or Flash Heal spell to be instant cast, cost no mana but be incapable of a critical hit.' DEPARTURE - no cast times, so 'instant' has nothing to act on, and nothing consumes a buff on use. The mana clause survives as a temporary cost reduction. MIND THE FLIP: all_ability_cost_pct is PERCENTAGE POINTS inside a status effect (25.0) and a FRACTION as a talent effect - this key is the one audit_talents has caught most often in this project.

nodes.name: Spiritual Healing
nodes.description: Increases all your healing by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 3, NEW to our tree, built verbatim: 'Increases the amount healed by your healing spells by 2%-10%.' healing_done is a FRACTION and is the global healing multiplier.

nodes.name: Holy Concentration
nodes.description: Your critical heals restore 180 mana.
nodes._source: WotLK row 4, NEW to our tree: 'Your mana regeneration from spirit is increased by 16%-50% for 8 sec after you critically heal.' DEPARTURE - there is no key that modifies mana regeneration at all (resource_regen_pct is dead data), so a temporary regeneration boost cannot be built. Delivered as mana on the same trigger the real talent uses.

nodes.name: Body and Soul
nodes.description: Increases the duration of your Power Word: Shield by 1 turn per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 4: 'When you cast Power Word: Shield, you increase the target's movement speed by 30%/60% for 4 sec, and you have a 100% chance to cleanse the target of all poison effects.' DEPARTURE - no movement speed, and a talent-sourced effect cannot be aimed at the shield's target. Delivered as shield duration, which is the clause's real beneficiary. ability_<id>_duration is FLAT turns and POSITIVE EXTENDS. Kept from the outgoing tree.

nodes.name: Empowered Healing
nodes.description: Increases the healing of your Heal by 4% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 4: 'Your Greater Heal spell gains an additional 8%-40% and your Flash Heal and Binding Heal gain an additional 4%-20% of your bonus healing effects.' None of the three named spells exist; priest_heal stands in for all of them at the middle value. Kept from the outgoing tree, corrected from 5% to 4% per rank.

nodes.name: Blessed Resilience
nodes.description: Increases your healing by 1% per rank and reduces the chance you are critically hit by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 4, built with both halves: 'Increases the effectiveness of your healing spells by 1%-3%, and critical hits made against you have a 20%-60% chance to prevent the critical.' Preventing a crit outright is not expressible, but crit_taken_reduction - which lowers an attacker's crit chance against you (abilities.py:1317) - is the same idea and is a live key in PERCENTAGE POINTS. Kept from the outgoing tree, which had the crit half only.

nodes.name: Serendipity
nodes.description: Your heals have a 33% chance per rank to quicken you by 12% for 2 turns.
nodes._source: WotLK row 4: 'When you heal with Binding Heal or Flash Heal, the cast time of your next Greater Heal or Prayer of Healing spell is reduced by 4%-12%.' DEPARTURE - no cast times. A shorter cast is haste, so that is what it grants, at the real 12%. Kept as a proc from the outgoing tree.

nodes.name: Empowered Renew
nodes.description: Increases the healing of your Renew by 5% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 5: 'Your Renew spell gains an additional 5%-15% of your bonus healing effects, and your Renew will instantly heal the target for 1-3 ticks worth of healing.' The throughput half is built verbatim. The instant-tick clause cannot be built - nothing converts a hot's pending ticks into a direct heal. Stacks with Improved Renew. Kept from the outgoing tree.

nodes.name: Circle of Healing
nodes.description: Teaches Circle of Healing, mending everyone around your target.
nodes._source: WotLK row 5, kept - the ONLY unlock for priest_circle_of_healing, which is requires_talent. Moved from tier 3 to its real row.

nodes.name: Divine Providence
nodes.description: Increases the healing of your Circle of Healing and Prayer of Healing by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 5: 'Increases the amount healed by Circle of Healing, Binding Heal, Holy Nova, Prayer of Healing, Divine Hymn and Prayer of Mending by 2%-10%.' Built verbatim for the two that exist. Stacks with Holy Reach. Kept from the outgoing tree.

nodes.name: Test of Faith
nodes.description: Increases your healing by 4% per rank on targets below half health.
nodes._source: WotLK row 5: 'Increases healing by 4%-12% on friendly targets at or below 50% health.' Built as a REAL conditional: low_health_healing_pct is the friendly-side mirror of low_health_damage_pct and is a live key. NOTE it is not ability-scoped, so it lifts all healing rather than a named list - which the real talent also does. low_health_threshold_pct is NOT authored: it SUMS across talents and the default is already what this wants. The outgoing version was a proc with no conditional at all.

nodes.name: Guardian Spirit
nodes.description: A guardian watches over you, greatly increasing healing you receive while badly wounded.
nodes._source: WotLK row 10, the capstone: 'Calls upon a guardian spirit to watch over the friendly target. The spirit increases the healing received by the target by 40%... and will sacrifice itself to prevent the target from dying.' DEPARTURE - no ability to unlock, a talent effect can never reach an ally, and there is no death-prevention hook. Delivered as both real clauses applied to the priest and conditioned on being badly hurt, which is when the real spell is cast. Both keys share low_health_threshold_pct's default, which is why it is not authored. The outgoing version was a proc with an empty effects dict.
